description: A cross between a modern SaaS dashboard (Microsoft Fluent inspired) and a family-friendly mission system. Professional enough for adults (Admins) but highly engaging, gamified, and rewarding for kids and teens. Clean light-theme layouts, frosted glass layering, rounded geometries, and bright gamification accents.

typography.font_strategy: Outfit provides a crisp, modern, and tech-forward SaaS feel for headers, while Nunito brings approachability, readability, and a friendly vibe for body text and gamified elements.

colors.strategy: High-contrast, light-themed Fluent UI with vibrant gamification accents.

primary.name: Electric Blue
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Active States, Mission Card highlights, User Dashboard headers.

secondary.name: Navy Blue
secondary.usage: Text color, Admin Dashboard headers, strong contrasts.

accent_success.name: Emerald Green
accent_success.usage: Completed tasks, Approvals, XP gained, Checkmarks.

accent_reward.name: Gold
accent_reward.usage: Level-up celebrations, Streaks, Achievement Badges, Tier ranks (Legend, etc).

surfaces_and_layouts.style: Microsoft Fluent inspired. High reliance on depth, layered shadows, and optical clarity.
surfaces_and_layouts.cards: Large corner radii (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl). Flat white backgrounds with a delicate 1px border (border-slate-100) and soft, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]).
surfaces_and_layouts.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, sticky bottom navigations (mobile PWA), and dialog overlays. Must have backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150.
surfaces_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. gap-6 to gap-8 between grid items.

dashboard_grid.admin_view: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Summary stats (col-span-1), Approvals Queue (col-span-2 row-span-2), Weekly Progress Chart (col-span-2 row-span-2).
dashboard_grid.user_view: Mobile-first vertical flow on small screens. On desktop: Today's Missions (col-span-8), Stats & Streak (col-span-4).

mission_card.layout: Flexbox row for lists, Flexbox col for board view. Must contain: Checkbox/Status, Title, Points Value (Gold color), Assignee Avatar, and Due Date.
mission_card.interactions: Hover state lifts the card (-translate-y-1) and increases shadow to shadow-md. If completed, background transitions to a very pale Emerald Green (bg-emerald-50) with an Emerald border.

xp_progress_bar.layout: Thick rounded-full track (h-4 to h-6) with an animated fill (Electric Blue or Gold gradient). Text overlays showing 'Current Level (e.g., Recruit)' on left, 'Next Level' on right.

achievement_badge.description: Gallery item in the Rewards Center.
achievement_badge.layout: Circular or Hexagonal 3D-looking element. Use heavy drop-shadow. When locked, use grayscale filter (grayscale opacity-50).

onboarding_flow.layout: Centered large card on a playful gradient or image background. Step 1: Welcome & Gamification introduction. Step 2: Role selection (Admin/Child) & avatars.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have clear hover states. Buttons scale up slightly (scale-105) and brighten. Cards lift.
motion_and_interactions.success_feedback: Use Sonner toasts for mission completions. Integrate a subtle confetti or glowing animation when an approval is granted.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Staggered fade-ins for dashboard widgets. The mission cards should pop in sequentially (framer-motion staggerChildren).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Gold text on White has a dark enough hue, or use Gold for backgrounds with Navy text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='mission-card-complete-btn'.

media_and_assets.icons: Use @heroicons/react for clean, approachable, Microsoft-fluent-compatible icons. For heavy gamification, consider @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style).

avatars.description: 3D cute toy character, ideal for kid profile placeholder

badges.description: 3D Gold achievement badge for Rewards Center
Round yellow 3D object for rank/level badge

onboarding.description: Cheerful family portrait for the welcome screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Light Theme with high optical clarity. The background should be very light gray/off-white so the white cards pop.
Do NOT use generic purple AI slop gradients. Stick strictly to the Electric Blue, Navy, Emerald, and Gold palette.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for main grid structures. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialogs, Progress, Tabs, Avatars) but heavily customize them to remove the 'Vercel look'.
Cards MUST have generous internal padding (p-6 minimum) and large rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
For the Level/XP progress bars, make them thick and obvious, as this is a core gamification mechanic.
In the User Dashboard, 'Missions' should feel like quest cards, not just a to-do list checkbox.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on every interactive element (e.g., 'approve-mission-button', 'avatar-selector').
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: make the UI feel distinctly like a modern family command center.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (blur-xl) for headers and overlays.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Never center align the App container using text-align: center.
Use sonner for toast notifications (success messages for chore completions).
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the provided image URLs.
All .js components should follow these guidelines. No .tsx files.
